request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft cello, gentle drums, hopeful and reflective mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
David feigned madness in fear
Abimelech drove him away
He left to find safety nearby
Blessing the Lord day by day

[Chorus]
My soul boasts in the Lord
Let the humble hear and rejoice
Magnify the Lord with me
Let us exalt his name together

[Verse]
I sought the Lord in my distress
He answered me and delivered
He saved me from all my fears
His light has fully arrived

[Chorus]
My soul boasts in the Lord
Let the humble hear and rejoice
Magnify the Lord with me
Let us exalt his name together

[Bridge]
Those who look to him shine
Radiant faces stand before him
Their shame has been washed away
His praise remains on my lips

[Chorus]
My soul boasts in the Lord
Let the humble hear and rejoice
Magnify the Lord with me
Let us exalt his name together

[Outro]
His praise will always be on my lips
My soul boasts in the Lord
